text: You're looking for a quick and flavorful dish that fits your gluten-free dietary needs and supports your goal of higher protein intake. Thai Chicken With Basil and Coconut Milk seems like a great fit. The recipe is gluten-free, and the chicken breast provides a good amount of protein, meeting your health goal. The combination of coconut milk and fresh basil adds a rich and aromatic flavor, making this recipe a satisfying option for you.
